We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Open to hiring remote across North America. We have offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Seattle.

Your background might be in editing, directing, design, animation, art direction or writing. What matters is that you’re already deeply embedded in AI-assisted creative workflows and are pushing the boundaries of what these tools can do. Editing is the core of the role, and you know how to cut short-form video that holds attention from the first frame to the last.

This is a making role. You’ll create work across formats, from short-form video and motion to design and editorial, using Runway’s products and the broader landscape of generative AI tools. Some days you’ll be cutting a launch-day Reel from generated footage. Other days you’ll be jumping on a trend the moment it breaks, building out tutorial content or exploring a creative application of a product feature no one’s tried yet. The output varies; the throughput and quality standard don’t.

Much of your work will sit at the top of the funnel, often as someone’s first encounter with Runway. It needs to stop the scroll, perform with the algorithm and feel native to each platform. You’ll also work in real time, turning model releases, trends and cultural moments into fast, reactive content while they’re still peaking.

You’ll sit within the creative department and report to the Social Media Lead. But the nature of the role means you’ll also work across product, research and marketing, often as the person who translates a product capability into a compelling creative artifact that’s geared to social audiences.

4112 - Financial Reporting & Control Accountant, UK (15 Month FTC)

Role Summary and Impact

The Financial Reporting & Control Accountant will support the delivery of accurate, timely and well-controlled financial reporting across the business. The role will support month-end and year-end ledger close, balance sheet control, intercompany accounting and resolution, transfer pricing compliance, statutory and audit requirements, and ongoing finance transformation. The role will work across Financial Control, Tax, Global Business Services and wider finance teams to ensure financial reporting is appropriately supported, issues are resolved on a timely basis and a strong control environment is maintained.

Responsibilities

Intercompany

• Monitor intercompany balances and reconciliations across relevant legal entities, ensuring material differences and aged items are identified and appropriately actioned.

• Coordinate and escalate unresolved intercompany mismatches and aged balances, working with Senior Financial Controllers, Global Business Services and counterparties to drive timely resolution.

• Oversee differences between the general ledger and Group intercompany matching/reporting systems, ensuring clear ownership and follow-up of outstanding items.

• Identify recurring intercompany issues and escalate control or process weaknesses where appropriate.

  Transfer Pricing & Compliance

• Coordinate the timely preparation of transfer pricing local files and supporting documentation, working with Tax, Senior Financial Controllers and relevant finance teams.

• Monitor transfer pricing compliance requirements and maintain a clear tracker of deliverables, owners and completion status.

Audit, Statutory Reporting & Compliance

• Support year-end statutory reporting and external audit, including preparation of schedules, supporting documentation and resolution of audit queries.

Ledger Close & Financial Reporting

• Coordinate the monthly, quarterly and year-end close, ensuring ledger activities, Flash and Actuals are completed accurately and within Group reporting deadlines.

• Take ownership of assigned balance sheet accounts, ensuring balances are accurate, appropriately supported and understood.

• Review and drive resolution of aged, unusual or unsupported balances, ensuring accounting is in line with Group policies and applicable accounting standards.

• Support key financial controls, including SOX, challenging control weaknesses and driving practical improvements.

Process Improvement & Transformation

• Identify opportunities to improve, standardise and automate financial reporting, reconciliation and control processes.

• Support system migrations, legal entity changes and finance transformation, including the cleansing of legacy balances and implementation of new processes and controls.

  Stakeholder Management

• Build effective relationships across Controllership, Global Business Services, Tax and wider finance teams to ensure timely resolution of reporting and accounting issues.

• Escalate significant accounting or control issues and help drive consistent accounting and control standards across the business.

  Skills and Experience

 

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA) or equivalent with relevant accounting experience.
